day.buzz.bad: Yesterday's video stung: guests are impatient
regular.taxi.1: Stuck on the ring road for an hour. Your smoke is the only thing that moves there.
regular.taxi.2: A fare asked me to go faster. I said: I am the traffic.
regular.taxi.3: New roadworks again. The detour goes right past you, lucky me.
regular.taxi.4: My sat-nav says turn left. Left is a lake.
regular.taxi.5: Rush hour started at noon today. To go, please, as always.
regular.taxi.6: I counted: three red lights from here to the centre, if you hurry.
regular.student.1: Exams start tomorrow. I revise best on a full stomach.
regular.student.2: Passed the first one! Barely, but passed.
regular.student.3: My scholarship arrived. This skewer is basically an investment.
regular.student.4: The lecturer asked what I know. I said: where the best shashlik is.
regular.student.5: Coursework is due at midnight. I have loads of time. Loads.
regular.student.6: Exams are over! I told my whole group about this place.
regular.granny.1: Take your time, dear. Just make it properly done.
regular.granny.2: My grandson says I should try the delivery apps. I say I have legs.
regular.granny.3: I planted tomatoes today. Yours are good, but wait until August.
regular.granny.4: In my day the queue was longer and nobody complained.
regular.granny.5: I brought you a jar of jam. Don't tell the other guests.
regular.granny.6: You have grown thin behind that grill. Eat something yourself.
regular.blogger.1: Hi everyone, today we test the famous mangal! No pressure.
regular.blogger.2: Last video got so many views. People want more sizzle.
regular.blogger.3: Can you flip it once more for the camera? Slowly.
regular.blogger.4: My followers ask what the secret is. I say: coals and patience.
regular.blogger.5: Light is perfect today. Please do not burn my hero shot.
regular.blogger.6: We hit a milestone thanks to your shashlik. This one is a celebration.

tutorial.place: Drag a raw skewer from the tray onto the grill
tutorial.flip: The bottom is browned — tap the skewer to flip it
tutorial.take: Cooked on both sides — drag it to the plate. Golden is best!
tutorial.serve: Drag the plate to the guest waiting for this order
tutorial.fan: Need more heat? Swipe across the coals to fan them
tutorial.coals: Heat running low? Add coals — it gets smoky for a few seconds
tutorial.side: Tap a side dish to put it on the plate
tutorial.splash: Flare-up! Tap the fire to splash it with water
tutorial.trash: Burnt! Drag it to the bucket — no guest will take it
